correctness.rationale: The infinite Hamiltonian-square A-sector decomposes into exact two-site blocks; a matrix cosine gives the amplitude. For irrational frequency ratio, Kronecker equidistribution plus the surjective sum/difference torus map yields independent arcsine variables. Their exact convolution gives the elliptic density. Reduced-rational parity and a phase-distance inequality prove the sharp qualitative exceptions and a strict quantitative ceiling. The actual verification script passed 71 checks, including 49 finite-matrix amplitudes, and is corroboration rather than a proof of the limit.

originality.rationale: The 2024 full-text preprint already gives the two-frequency local amplitude and discrete exact-transfer tuning, so these are explicitly excluded from novelty. Vinet–Zhedanov and Banchi et al. already develop general Kronecker-based almost-perfect state transfer, so the arithmetic method is also not claimed new. The additional physical observable is the exact time-empirical fidelity law with flux-independent elliptic density and universal high-fidelity tail. Primary full-text comparisons and actual semantic searches revealed no statement-level prior result that implies this specialized law; general arcsine-product identities alone require identifying the applicable dynamical measure.
residual_risks: An equivalent time-statistics result may exist in specialized flat-band or quasiperiodic quantum-dynamics literature not captured by the actual searches.
The later journal edition of the 2024 preprint was not materially inspected in full; its later supplementary material may bear on priority.
The elliptic density is a classical product-of-arcsines calculation; novelty must not be read as discovery of that probability identity or general equidistribution.

value.rationale: The exact fraction of readout times above a threshold is a directly motivated, measurable resource in static flat-band transport. The density law supplies the entire fidelity distribution, a universal small-infidelity expansion, and dense rational exceptions with an explicit obstruction. This goes beyond evaluating the previously known amplitude at predetermined optimum times and beyond merely asserting recurrence. No claim is made about the practical finite-time waiting scale.
